tasks.title: OMEL Contamination Guard — scripts/lib/omel/contamination-guard.ts
tasks.description: Create scripts/lib/omel/contamination-guard.ts. ContaminationGuard class with: (1) claimContext(agentId: string, taskId: string): ContaminationContext — registers agent as active on taskId. (2) releaseContext(agentId: string, taskId: string): void — releases agent's active context. (3) checkAccess(requestingAgentId: string, targetAgentId: string, targetTaskId: string): boolean — returns true if access is allowed (same agent+task or no active context), logs CONTAMINATION_ATTEMPT and returns false if different agent. (4) getActiveContext(agentId: string): ContaminationContext | null. JSONL audit log to logs/omel/contamination-guard-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl. Export singleton contaminationGuard. Interface: ContaminationContext = {agentId: string; taskId: string; startedAt: string}. File must be <300 lines.
tasks.context: AMD-13 OMEL Sprint 180. ContaminationGuard is the task context isolation layer. Pattern: Map<agentId, ContaminationContext> tracking which task each agent is currently running. Cross-context read = another agent trying to access a different agent's active context. JSONL logging pattern reuse from scripts/lib/omel/wipe-witness.ts (appendLog function). Singleton export pattern: export const contaminationGuard = new ContaminationGuard(). File must be <300 lines. No destructive writes to existing files. DO NOT modify orchestrate-agents-v2.ts.

tasks.title: OMEL Phase 1 Gate validator — scripts/validate-sprint-180.ts
tasks.description: Create scripts/validate-sprint-180.ts. Gate validator that: (1) imports all 5 OMEL singletons from scripts/lib/omel/index.ts and verifies they are non-null objects. (2) Verifies OMEL log directory exists (logs/omel/). (3) Writes gate report to workspace/gates/omel-phase1-gate.json with fields: {status: 'PASS'|'FAIL', sprint: 'sprint-180', ts: ISO timestamp, checks: Array<{name: string, passed: boolean, detail?: string}>}.
